newsitem.title: USA: Neenah Corp to sell $140 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Neenah Corp to sell $140 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: Neenah Corp is expected to issue $140 million in high-yield securities over the next several weeks in connection with a leveraged buyout of the company, market sources said.
Proceeds from the offering will be combined with bank debt and equity investments to finance the buyout, which is being led by Citicorp Venture Capital, market sources said.
The company, based in Neenah, Wisconsin, is one of the largest manufacturers of iron castings such as manhole covers and sewer grates, for municipal and industrial customers.
Chase Securities Inc will be lead manager for the 144a private placement of 10-year senior subordinated notes.
Standard and Poor's has rated the notes B-minus.
S&P stated the company's high leverage and modest cash flow coverage resulted in high financial risk for debtholders.
The agency noted, however, "given a favorable near term operating outlook, funds from operations should be adequate to meet modest capital expenditures and required debt amortization."
Citicorp Venture Capital, Neenah and Chase officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
